description: "Heretics And Heresies" by Robert Green Ingersoll is a critical examination of religious intolerance and the historical persecution of those deemed heretics, written in the late 19th century. This work is characterized as an essay or philosophical treatise, exploring themes of freedom of thought, the dangers of dogma, and the moral implications of religious doctrine.
